entities.summary: Over 50 million Yoruba in West Africa, the Caribbean, and Brazil. Their Oyo Empire and Ifẹ̀ kingdom legacy includes a sophisticated Orisha religious system, bronze and brass casting rivaling Renaissance Italy, and one of Africa's richest literary traditions.
